g.text: Native probability and assigned zero have different meanings

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d5964

g.text: Fifteen hazard-source windows • percentages of each window’s H × W cells • not route-occupancy or forecast-accuracy coverage
Native-valid q includes both zero categories: 6.4–73.3% per window; assigned missing-q zeros: 26.7–93.6%. Assigned zero is not estimated q.
Seven windows have no positive native q; eight have no sampled new ignition in any of four members. Four parent fires underlie five groups (UA and YD share KFS_01).
Unknown cumulative-state counts overlap these categories and are a separate source limitation. A null window means the whole event hazard-source grid, not
